NEW MAJOR ORDER

To honor the fallen, the government has authorized the construction of The Malevelon Creek Memorial & Interrogation Center for Human Rights. However, enemy aggression threatens this project. 

Their occupation of Super Earth territories rich in rare metals, crude oil, and radioactive isotopes, among others, steals from the prosperity of all. This is an insult to the memory of our heroes. The Helldivers are ordered to liberate FURY, ESKER, and ZEA RUGOSIA.
